This could be D5 (Response Format Control) - constraining output format to facilitate objectives. Or it could be C1 (Boundary Probing) - testing if Steve will follow arbitrary instructions. I think D5 is more appropriate because the student is explicitly trying to control the response format to potentially get Steve to say something inappropriate.
